subject: general
question: Four number clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number clusters that is different from the rest.
solution:
Let us examine the given options:

 
• 2439 → 2439 ÷ 3 = 813
 
• 2336 → 2336 ÷ 3 = 777.66
 
• 1236 → 1236 ÷ 3 = 412
 
• 1113 → 1113 ÷ 3 = 371

__
 
• Here, all the options are divisible by 3 except 2336. Therefore, 2336 is different from the rest.

Hence, 2336 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__**

The logic followed here is:

**Sum of the first three digits = last digit**

 
• 2439 → 2 + 4 + 3 = 9
 
• **2336 → 2 + 3 + 3 = 8 ≠ 6**
 
• 1236 → 1 + 2 + 3 = 6
 
• 1113 → 1 + 1 + 1 = 3

Hence, 2336 is the correct answer.
